name: Life of Tabayama
source:
You play as Hirohito Ishida, a charismatic yet troubled high school student. At first, life seems perfect—spending time with friends, enjoying school days, and feeling the first signs of love. But after the mysterious disappearance of your childhood friend Kumiko, everything changes. Secrets unravel. Trust fades. And what seemed like an ordinary life becomes a descent into horror.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3632810/Life_of_Tabayama/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你扮演石田裕仁，一位魅力十足但又陷入困境的高中生。起初，生活似乎很完美——与朋友共度时光，享受学生时代，感受初恋的迹象。但在你儿时好友久美子神秘失踪后，一切都发生了变化。秘密揭开。信任逐渐消失。看似平凡的生活却陷入了恐怖。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3632810/Life_of_Tabayama/]Steam[/url]]
